title: Blog post
description: Adds a blog post in both languages: src/content/blog/<slug>.md (English) and <slug>.es.md (Spanish), with the same base_slug so /en/blog/<slug> and /es/blog/<slug> are each other's translation. Write the Spanish natively, in neutral Spanish with "tú".

slug.description: Address of the post in both languages (e.g. why-one-board)

descriptionEn.description: One-sentence summary in English: listing card and meta description

bodyEn.description: Markdown body in English (## for sections). Defaults to a short placeholder to replace

category.description: One of the blog's categories (loom.json blog.categories); defaults to the first

draft.description: Keep it out of the build until it is ready

replace.description: Write the post again when it exists, in both languages (needs --yes)

examples.titleEn: Why one board beats ten tools
examples.titleEs: Por qué un tablero le gana a diez herramientas
